summary: Iteration 10 frontend verification. Routing (/ /safeseed /verify-log), no shared toolkit nav, SafeSeed assurance-basis citation block, rename-doesn't-collapse fix, verify-log full happy+failure paths, and the Redactorium footer link ALL pass. Signed-log end-to-end works: download-json-log-btn output verifies as 'SIGNATURE VALID' with correct key and 'SIGNATURE INVALID · signature does not match secret' with wrong key. Structure grep clean (no @/lib/ or shared @/components/[A-Z] leaks from redactorium/safeseed). ONE CRITICAL BUG: SafeSeed 'Import JSON…' modal is entirely broken — clicking open-import-schema throws 'Too many re-renders. React limits the number of renders to prevent an infinite loop.' The modal never mounts, so import-textarea / import-example-btn / import-apply-btn / import-error and the 5-row apply flow could not be tested. Root cause is a setState-during-render anti-pattern in ImportSchemaModal.jsx line 37. Also horizontal overflow at 320px (all 3 pages) and 360px (/safeseed) exceeds the spec tolerance of +1px.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal throws 'Too many re-renders' immediately on open, entire Import Schema feature unusable. React error boundary shows on screen. Root cause: line 36-39 computes `preview` via an IIFE that calls `setErr("")` synchronously during render. Even though React should bail on Object.is equality for primitives, the Emergent Visual Editor instrumentation + strict-mode double render trips the 25-render fuse. Fix: remove setErr from the render body; use useMemo for preview and a useEffect(text) to clear err (or just clear err only inside validate()/apply()).

Horizontal overflow beyond spec tolerance (+1px). Measured (scrollWidth − innerWidth): /@320=+33, /safeseed@320=+26, /verify-log@320=+33, /safeseed@360=+6. Pages fit at 390/768/820. Likely culprits: Redactorium masthead/hero text sizing, and on /safeseed the SchemaEditor row (pre-existing from iteration 9).

integration_issues.issue: Cannot test invalid-JSON error, unknown-type error, load-example → apply → 5 rows appear → activePreset nulled flow because modal crashes on mount. All import-* testids untestable until re-render bug is fixed.

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: In /app/frontend/src/safeseed/components/ImportSchemaModal.jsx remove `setErr("")` from the render-body IIFE (line 37). Replace `const preview = (()=>{ try { setErr(""); return normalize(text);} catch { return null; } })();` with `const preview = useMemo(() => { try { return normalize(text); } catch { return null; } }, [text]);` and reset err from within `validate`/`apply` (or a `useEffect([text])` that only clears when err is truthy). Verify the modal opens, then re-run the import flow tests.

Reduce horizontal overflow at 320/360: audit Redactorium masthead sizing on / and /verify-log (headline 'REDACTORIUM' likely too wide), and the /safeseed SchemaEditor row that already overflowed in iteration 9.
critical_code_review_comments: ImportSchemaModal.jsx: setState during render is an anti-pattern React will punish under strict mode / instrumentation. Always compute derived values with useMemo, never with setState-in-render.
App.js still uses `path='*' -> RedactoriumPage` catch-all — any typo silently lands on Redactorium (carried over from iteration 9). Consider a real 404 or a redirect to `/` for clarity.

PresetPicker.jsx line 73 renders dynamic text inside <option>, which the Visual Editor wraps in <span>, producing the recurring dev-console 'span cannot be a child of option' warning. To silence in dev, render the label as a plain string with no interpolation container: `<option>{p.label}</option>` where p.label is a single string variable (currently likely `{p.label}` interpolation is picked up as dynamic). Cosmetic; safe in prod.

rca of the issue: ImportSchemaModal.jsx line 36-39: `const preview = (() => { try { setErr(''); return normalize(text); } catch { return null; } })();` — setState called synchronously during render. React 18 strict mode + Emergent Visual Editor's re-execution of the render body compounds the state update and trips 'Too many re-renders'. Reproduction: on /safeseed click [data-testid=open-import-schema] → modal never appears, red 'Uncaught runtime errors: Too many re-renders' overlay shows. Mitigation: derive `preview` with `useMemo(() => { try { return normalize(text); } catch { return null; } }, [text])` and only mutate `err` inside `validate()` / `apply()` (or a `useEffect` on text that clears err when the parse newly succeeds).
